title: Stated terms
description: A provider's terms for one tuple as stated at one time (REQ-QTE-6): its fee formula and, where its tuple sets a rate, its slippage regime, with when it stated them. Core keeps each tuple's history of these, keyed by its tuple; the terms that bind a segment are the last stated at or before it started, and before that the route's total is a quote. Each comes from the provider's signed terms, urn:rutent:provider-role:terms.

tuple.description: The tuple they are for, by its provider and its two ends.

stated_at.description: When they bind from: the later of the provider's made_at and Core's received_at of its signed terms (urn:rutent:provider-role:terms), never made_at alone, so terms dated before a segment started but received after it never bind it.

slippage.description: The slippage regime, where the tuple sets a rate.
